import json,os,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/workspace/p35-full-height-20261125')

env=os.environ.copy()
env.update(LEAN_NUM_THREADS='1',LAKE_NO_CACHE='true',LAKE_ARTIFACT_CACHE='false',MATHLIB_NO_CACHE_ON_UPDATE='1')
def checked(args): subprocess.run(args,cwd=root,env=env,check=True)

results=[]
for name in ['Part3RegularPositiveMeasureExhaustion','Part3ContinuousTraceCauchy','Part3ContinuousTraceExhaustion']:
    log=out/(name+'.log')
    print('START '+name,flush=True)
    tick=time.monotonic()
    with log.open('w') as f:
        p=subprocess.run(['lake','build','ImbalancedChen.'+name],cwd=root,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    data=log.read_text(errors='replace')
    results.append({'module':name,'exit_code':p.returncode,'elapsed_seconds':round(time.monotonic()-tick,3),'log':str(log)})
    (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(results[-1]),flush=True)
    if p.returncode:
        marker=data.rfind('✖')
        print(data[marker:] if marker>=0 else data[-16000:],flush=True)
        sys.exit(p.returncode)
    own=[x for x in data.splitlines() if any((n+'.lean:') in x or ('Built ImbalancedChen.'+n) in x for n in ['Part3RegularCumulativeShellPayment',name])]
    print('\n'.join(own),flush=True)
